advancements.hextale.root.title: HexTale

rune.hextale.fire_water.effect: Fire over water - steam. Steam that pushes?
rune.hextale.fire_water.use: Mechanism: a steam drive that moves pistons without redstone.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.effect: Heat turned on the earth. Ore and sand might melt by themselves.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.use: Pickaxe: ore drops as ingots, sand as glass.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.hint: Heat aimed at ore gives ingots by itself.
rune.hextale.fire_air.effect: Fire riding the wind. A cone of flame?
rune.hextale.fire_air.use: Gauntlets: a jet of fire 5 blocks long.
rune.hextale.fire_light.effect: A flame that shines and never needs feeding. Can that be?
rune.hextale.fire_light.use: Mechanism: a lantern without fuel that lights the lanterns next to it.
rune.hextale.fire_light.hint: A flame that shines without wood, forever.
rune.hextale.fire_shadow.effect: A fire that seems to hate the dark and what lives in it.
rune.hextale.fire_shadow.use: Sword: double damage to the undead, burns cobwebs.
rune.hextale.fire_life.effect: Fire that catches on the living at a touch. Careful.
rune.hextale.fire_life.use: Weapon: sets the target on fire on hit.
rune.hextale.fire_metal.effect: Fire that wants metal back. Broken things melted into ingots again?
rune.hextale.fire_metal.use: Mechanism: a smelter that returns ingots from broken tools.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.effect: All the heat at once. It feels dangerous even on paper.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.use: Drill: blasts the 3×3 blocks around the point of impact.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.hint: All the heat at once. Dangerous.
rune.hextale.water_fire.effect: Water against fire. Lava would cool into stone.
rune.hextale.water_fire.use: Staff: puts out fires around, lava turns to obsidian.
rune.hextale.water_fire.hint: Water douses fire and cools lava.
rune.hextale.water_earth.effect: Water that washes loose earth away, layer by layer.
rune.hextale.water_earth.use: Shovel: sand, gravel and dirt go in whole layers.
rune.hextale.water_air.effect: Water breathed into the air. A thick fog to hide in?
rune.hextale.water_air.use: Device: a cloud in which mobs lose their target.
rune.hextale.water_light.effect: Light gathered like a drop of water - the far looks near.
rune.hextale.water_light.use: Spyglass monocle: zooms in and highlights distant targets.
rune.hextale.water_shadow.effect: Water that drags down and holds. Like a swamp.
rune.hextale.water_shadow.use: Trap: mobs get stuck and slowly sink.
rune.hextale.water_life.use: Staff: heals creatures and players around.
rune.hextale.water_life.hint: Water washes wounds. Turn it on the living.
rune.hextale.water_metal.effect: Water that eats metal. Rust in a moment?
rune.hextale.water_metal.use: Weapon: ruins enemy armour, takes apart other people's mechanisms.
rune.hextale.water_spark.effect: A charge running along water. Where would it end up?
rune.hextale.water_spark.use: Mechanism: carries energy along a water channel.
rune.hextale.earth_fire.effect: Earth tempered by fire - harder, unafraid of heat. Could a tool be made like that?
rune.hextale.earth_fire.use: Any tool: loses durability half as fast, does not burn in lava.
rune.hextale.earth_fire.hint: Stone does not fear fire. Could a tool?
rune.hextale.earth_water.effect: Earth that holds water back. Even lava, maybe.
rune.hextale.earth_water.use: Device: seals water and lava behind a wall.
rune.hextale.earth_water.hint: A wall of earth holds back even lava.
rune.hextale.earth_air.effect: Earth pulling the air down. Whatever flies would fall.
rune.hextale.earth_air.use: Weapon: knocks down flying mobs, cancels knockback.
rune.hextale.earth_light.effect: Light woken inside stone. Gems where there was only rock?
rune.hextale.earth_light.use: Pickaxe: a chance to get a gem or a hextech shard.
rune.hextale.earth_shadow.effect: Earth that hides things in its shadow. Something might be waiting in the soil.
rune.hextale.earth_shadow.use: Mechanism: a hidden chest that looks like any other block.
rune.hextale.earth_life.effect: Earth made fertile. Things would grow out of it gladly.
rune.hextale.earth_life.use: Hoe: farmland never dries out, crops grow faster.
rune.hextale.earth_metal.effect: Earth bound with metal. A wall that holds together.
rune.hextale.earth_spark.effect: A spark led into the ground. Grounding for anything that charges too much.
rune.hextale.earth_spark.use: Mechanism: a lightning rod that protects machines from overload.
rune.hextale.air_fire.effect: Air feeding the fire. Like bellows - hotter, faster.
rune.hextale.air_fire.use: Mechanism: bellows, furnaces and smelters work twice as fast.
rune.hextale.air_water.effect: Wind drives the waves. Could it drive water through pipes?
rune.hextale.air_water.use: Mechanism: a pump that drains and moves water and lava.
rune.hextale.air_water.hint: Wind drives the waves. Could it drive water?
rune.hextale.air_earth.effect: A gust moves dust. Why not a whole block?
rune.hextale.air_earth.use: Mechanism: a rune piston that moves up to 12 blocks.
rune.hextale.air_earth.hint: A gust moves dust. Why not a whole block?
rune.hextale.air_light.effect: A reflection in the air that isn't there.
rune.hextale.air_light.use: Device: an illusion that mobs attack.
rune.hextale.air_shadow.effect: Air that swallows sound. Every step goes quiet.
rune.hextale.air_shadow.use: Boots: neither mobs nor sculk can hear the player.
rune.hextale.air_life.effect: Air given to the living. A breath where there is none.
rune.hextale.air_life.use: Helmet: breathing underwater, an air bubble.
rune.hextale.air_metal.effect: Air under metal - heavy things rising like feathers.
rune.hextale.air_metal.use: Mechanism: a lift and a crane for blocks and entities.
rune.hextale.air_spark.effect: Catch the wind and turn it into a charge.
rune.hextale.air_spark.use: Mechanism: a wind generator, stronger up high.
rune.hextale.air_spark.hint: Catch the wind and make it a charge.
rune.hextale.light_fire.effect: Heat gathered into a thin beam. It would cut.
rune.hextale.light_fire.use: Cutter: cuts blocks along a line, a long-range shot.
rune.hextale.light_water.effect: Light poured into water - clean and clear. Poisons wouldn't stay.
rune.hextale.light_water.use: Flask: removes poisons and negative effects.
rune.hextale.light_earth.effect: Light sent into stone shows what hides inside.
rune.hextale.light_earth.use: Goggles: ores and caves show through walls.
rune.hextale.light_earth.hint: Light sent into stone shows what hides.
rune.hextale.light_air.effect: A beam thrown into the sky, seen from far away.
rune.hextale.light_air.use: Beacon marker: seen from afar, links devices together.
rune.hextale.light_shadow.effect: Light that drives the darkness off. And what crawls out of it?
rune.hextale.light_shadow.use: Device: hostile mobs do not spawn around it.
rune.hextale.light_life.effect: Light that feeds the living. Plants would love it - and maybe more.
rune.hextale.light_life.use: Lamp: crops grow underground and at night.
rune.hextale.light_metal.effect: A pattern burned into metal by light.
rune.hextale.light_metal.use: Workbench: transfers runes onto tools and parts.
rune.hextale.light_spark.use: Mechanism: a light panel that works by day.
rune.hextale.shadow_fire.use: Mechanism: cools overheated machines, puts furnaces out.
rune.hextale.shadow_water.effect: Shadow that soaks up any liquid.
rune.hextale.shadow_water.use: Device: drains water and lava around it.
rune.hextale.shadow_earth.effect: Stone made passable for a heartbeat.
rune.hextale.shadow_earth.use: Gauntlets: walk through a wall up to 2 blocks thick.
rune.hextale.shadow_air.effect: Shadow spilled into the air hides whoever stands in it.
rune.hextale.shadow_air.hint: Shadow spilled into the air hides anyone.
rune.hextale.shadow_light.effect: Shadow that puts the light out. Even torches?
rune.hextale.shadow_light.use: Device: darkness around it, torches go out.
rune.hextale.shadow_life.effect: Shadow that drains life - and where does that life go?
rune.hextale.shadow_life.use: Weapon: part of the damage heals the wielder.
rune.hextale.shadow_metal.use: Weapon: enemy armour and tools break quickly.
rune.hextale.shadow_spark.use: Device: shuts down mechanisms around it.
rune.hextale.life_fire.use: Armour: immunity to fire and lava for a while.
rune.hextale.life_water.effect: Life giving birth to water. A spring from nothing?
rune.hextale.life_earth.effect: Life from the soil - sprouts in a heartbeat.
rune.hextale.life_earth.use: Staff: trees and crops grow at once.
rune.hextale.life_earth.hint: Life from the soil: sprouts in a heartbeat.
rune.hextale.life_air.effect: Seeds carried off on the wind.
rune.hextale.life_air.use: Mechanism: plants seeds around by itself.
rune.hextale.life_light.effect: The living starts to glow. Hard to hide like that.
rune.hextale.life_light.use: Arrows: highlight the target through walls.
rune.hextale.life_shadow.use: Weapon: passive and weak mobs fall asleep.
rune.hextale.life_metal.effect: Life heals flesh. Could it mend steel?
rune.hextale.life_metal.hint: Life heals flesh. Could it mend steel?
rune.hextale.life_spark.effect: A spark that wakes what has stopped.
rune.hextale.metal_fire.effect: Fire locked inside metal - a furnace that is always hot.
rune.hextale.metal_fire.use: Mechanism: a rune furnace and smelter.
rune.hextale.metal_water.effect: Liquid led through metal, where I want it.
rune.hextale.metal_earth.effect: A chisel that bites into stone.
rune.hextale.metal_earth.hint: A chisel that bites into stone.
rune.hextale.metal_air.effect: Metal spinning the air - blades, wind, cutting.
rune.hextale.metal_air.use: Mechanism: a fan that blows entities and items away.
rune.hextale.metal_light.effect: Metal that throws light back. And everything else?
rune.hextale.metal_shadow.use: Device: chests and doors open only with a rune key.
rune.hextale.metal_life.effect: Metal given a semblance of life.
rune.hextale.metal_spark.effect: In metal, a charge starts turning wheels.
rune.hextale.metal_spark.use: Mechanism: an engine for every machine.
rune.hextale.metal_spark.hint: In metal, a charge starts turning wheels.
rune.hextale.spark_fire.effect: A spark that sets things alight on a signal.
rune.hextale.spark_water.effect: Water that bites whoever stands in it.
rune.hextale.spark_water.use: Trap: damages everyone in the water.
rune.hextale.spark_earth.effect: A discharge struck into the ground. The stone would crack.
rune.hextale.spark_earth.use: Hammer: stuns everything around and crushes stone.
rune.hextale.spark_air.effect: Lightning leaping from target to target.
rune.hextale.spark_air.hint: Lightning leaps from target to target.
rune.hextale.spark_shadow.effect: A discharge that carries me through the shadow. A step, and I'm somewhere else.
rune.hextale.spark_shadow.use: Gauntlets: a teleporting dash of 8 blocks.
rune.hextale.spark_life.effect: A spark in the blood - faster, lighter.
rune.hextale.spark_metal.effect: Lightning loves iron. Let it pull iron.
rune.hextale.spark_metal.use: Mechanism: collects dropped items and ore.
rune.hextale.spark_metal.hint: Lightning loves iron. Let it pull iron.

gui.hextale.research_table.need.own_diar: This diary belongs to someone else. Bring your own.

block.hextale.brass_pipe.side.closed.pip: Shut off from the next pipe
item.hextale.essence_flask.mixture.hint: Everything at once, all mixed up. It needs pulling apart.

gui.hextale.separator.extract: Concentrate of the chosen essence: leaves through the concentrate outlets

gui.hextale.alembic.out: Leaves through a pipe on any side, or into glass bottles
gui.hextale.separator.rest: The rest of the mixture: leaves through the rest outlets

gui.hextale.slot.alembic.output: A filled bottle of essence comes out here

gui.hextale.slot.separator.extract: The bottled concentrate comes out here
gui.hextale.slot.separator.rest: The bottled rest of the mixture comes out here
gui.hextale.research_table.ink.no_storag: No storage: place an Essence Jar of %s concentrate within 5 blocks of the table
gui.hextale.separator.ports.hint: The separator seen from above, its front towards you. Click a side to choose what its pipe does - or sneak-use that side of the block.
gui.hextale.port.inlet.hint: A pipe here brings the mixture in (green, arrow in)
gui.hextale.port.product.hint: The wanted product leaves here (blue, arrow out)
gui.hextale.port.waste.hint: The by-product leaves here (rust, stopcock, arrow out)
gui.hextale.port.none.hint: Nothing goes in or out here; no pipe joins it
gui.hextale.separator.vent.hint: The top lets out the gas of separation
item.hextale.essence_flask.unknown.hint: Dark murk left over after separating. No good for ink. Where to put it?
block.hextale.drain_valve.open: Valve open: what the pipes bring pours out
gui.hextale.alembic.water.hint: Each item boils in %s mB. Pipe water in from a Pump on any side, or pour a water bucket on the alembic
jei.hextale.boiling.heat: Heat under the alembic: fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma
jei.hextale.boiling.result: A mixture of the item's essences - study the item at the Research Table to know them
jei.hextale.info.alembic: Boil a thing in water long enough and its essences rise out of it - but only things I have studied give anything clear; the rest boils into dark murk. It wants heat below and water inside, a little for every item. What comes out fills glass bottles or runs off through a pipe.
jei.hextale.info.separator: A flask over burning blaze powder: it draws one essence out of a mixture and leaves the rest, darkened.
jei.hextale.info.essence_tank: A big glass jar with a wooden lid. It takes from the top and the sides and gives from below. A desk nearby seems to drink from jars of pure essence.
jei.hextale.info.brass_pipe: Pipes for essence and water. They only join a machine where it has a port. A side can be shut, opened one way in, or one way out - out even pumps a jar empty. (Shift + right click a side with an empty hand)
jei.hextale.info.pump: Stood in water, it pushes the water up into the pipe on its top.
jei.hextale.info.drain_valve: A handwheel that opens or shuts it. Open, it pours out whatever the pipes bring. The stone under the stream seems to change... (Right click - open or shut)
jei.hextale.info.research_table: My desk, two blocks wide. The loupe on its arm shows what a thing is made of - I drag it onto an item and wait. On the parchment I work out devices: the diary, a hextech orb, paper, and ink drawn from the orb to every point. The ink comes from jars nearby. The finished notes teach me how to make the thing.
jei.hextale.info.essence_flask: A glass bottle of essence. One pure essence flows like ink; a mixture still needs pulling apart, and what is left after that is dark murk.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.essence_flask: a bottle in the alembic's slot
commands.hextale.quests.reset: Reset the Researcher's Path quests of %s
quest.hextale.research_table.desc: A proper desk at last, wide enough for the diary, the paper and a hextech orb. On one tab I choose what to work out, on the other I do the work. Two blocks wide - I'll need room.
quest.hextale.brass.goal: melt Brass in the Hex Furnace
quest.hextale.brass.desc: Copper alone is too soft, but with a little zinc it melts into a warm, stubborn metal. Brass. It feels like everything I build will start with it.
quest.hextale.unstable_hextech.desc: They say lightning likes to strike a rod. What if the rod stands on amethyst? The crystal could take the strike and change... I need a thunderstorm and some patience.
quest.hextale.researchers_diary.desc: A plain book, a shard of amethyst, a feather - and now it's mine, with my name on the first page. Everything I find out goes in here. Without it the desk is just a desk.
quest.hextale.item_study.desc: The loupe on the desk swings out on its arm. If I drag it onto a thing and hold still while the lenses fold in, maybe I'll see what it is really made of.
quest.hextale.alembic.desc: Boil a thing in water long enough and its essences rise out of it. But only things I have looked at closely give anything clear - the rest boils into dark murk. It needs heat below and water inside.
quest.hextale.brass_pipe.desc: Carrying bottles back and forth is tiring. Pipes, then. They only join a machine where it has a port - I can see the joint appear. And a side can be shut or turned one way. (Shift + right click with an empty hand)
quest.hextale.pump.desc: Water by the bucket again... What if something stood right in the spring and pushed the water up the pipe by itself?
quest.hextale.essence_bottle.desc: The alembic fills glass bottles with what it boiled out. It's not ink yet - everything the thing held is mixed together. I'll have to pull it apart somehow.
quest.hextale.separator.desc: If I could draw out just one essence and leave the rest... A flask over burning blaze powder might do it. What stays behind darkens, though.
quest.hextale.drain_valve.desc: The dark rest has to go somewhere. A valve with a handwheel could pour it out... I wonder what it does to the stone it falls on.
quest.hextale.concentrate.desc: One essence, pure, nothing else in it. It flows like ink. I think this is what the desk has been waiting for.
quest.hextale.essence_tank.desc: A big glass jar to keep the essence in. It takes from the top and the sides, gives from below. A label might teach it to keep only one kind...
quest.hextale.ink.goal: open the table with a jar of concentrate nearby
quest.hextale.ink.desc: The desk drinks ink from the jars nearby - a different essence for every research, so I'd better keep many jars. Everything sealed in my guide waits to be worked out here. Let's see how far the ink will run.
goggles.hextale.network: In the vessels on this network:
quest.hextale.researchers_goggles.desc: Lenses tinted with essence... If I wear them, maybe I'll see what is inside the jars and pipes without opening anything.
research.hextale.burst: A curse! The orb burst and the parchment of %s burned with the ink spent on it. A fresh sheet holds a new board.
research.hextale.burnt: The parchment of %s burned. A fresh sheet holds a new board.
quest.hextale.hexcore.goal: wake the altar into a Hexcore
quest.hextale.hexcore.desc: What if the altar's own heart were the work? A gemstone in the centre, and when the ritual ends the altar should wake up as something else - a living matrix of runes. What it could make that the altar cannot - I have yet to find out. Heavy rituals make it restless: arcs, fire, broken things. Maybe lightning rods around the circle would calm it?
jei.hextale.info.hexcore: The altar woken up: made by a ritual with a gemstone in the centre, the altar itself turns into it. Runs every altar ritual; the heavier the ritual, the more it throws arcs - at people, at fragile blocks, at the pedestals. Lightning rods in the circle catch some of them.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.empty: Put an item on the altar first
block.hextale.hextech_altar.nothing: The circle does not know what to do with this: check the pedestals, steles and jars
block.hextale.hextech_altar.busy: A ritual is running - sneak + use to abort it (what was drawn is lost)
block.hextale.hextech_altar.hint: The heart of the circle. The item goes on top, and then - the ritual. (Right click with the item; right click with a Magic Wand - start)
gui.hextale.stele.subtitle: Choose a rune for the circle
gui.hextale.stele.refuse.twice: Already on another stele of this circle
gui.hextale.stele.none: No rune does anything for the item on the altar.
gui.hextale.stele.unknown: A rune you have not learned yet
gui.hextale.stele.choose: Click: set it on the stele
book.hextale.quest.infusion.missing: The altar recipe is not loaded
quest.hextale.hextech_altar.desc: Everything I've read points here: a ritual circle. The item on the altar, the rest laid on pedestals around it, runes on steles, jars of essence close by. Then I start it and hope it holds. (Right click with a Magic Wand)
quest.hextale.pedestal.desc: Small stands for the things a ritual needs, close to the altar. One extra thing on them and the altar frowns - it marks it in red.
quest.hextale.rune_stele.desc: A stone that holds a rune I know. Near the altar it lends the rune to the ritual... and it only offers what makes sense for the thing on the altar.
quest.hextale.hextech_pickaxe.desc: An iron pickaxe with a hextech crystal set into it. It digs well as it is - but there is room in it for something more. Runes?
jei.hextale.info.hextech_altar: The heart of the ritual circle. The item on top, the rest on pedestals around it, runes on steles, jars of essence close by. When it starts, the pedestals give up their items one by one, then the jars their essences. Chalk runes drawn around it seem to hurry the work. (Right click with a Magic Wand, or a redstone pulse)
jei.hextale.info.pedestal: A stand for one thing a ritual needs, close to the altar. As many as I like. Hoppers can fill it too.
jei.hextale.info.rune_stele: A stone that holds one rune I know. Near the altar it guides the ritual.
gui.hextale.separator.choose.hint: Click: choose from all essences. Right click: clear. Wheel: next / previous
gui.hextale.separator.missing: The mixture holds none of it
gui.hextale.separator.no_fuel.hint: One blaze powder draws 32 mB of the chosen essence
gui.hextale.slot.separator.fuel: Blaze powder: burned to draw the chosen essence out
item.hextale.unstable_hextech.volatile: Looks very fragile - I'd better not drop it.
item.hextale.hextech_gemstone.tooltip: Smooth and steady, not a tremor left in it.
quest.hextale.hextech_gemstone.goal: finish a Hextech Gemstone on the lapidary
quest.hextale.hextech_gemstone.desc: Ground smooth and steady, it no longer trembles at all. The purest thing I've made from hextech. It feels like it could hold much more than the cut crystal.
quest.hextale.hextech_lamp.desc: A crystal floating in a little brass cage, glowing as bright as day. It stands or hangs - wherever I need light.
jei.hextale.info.hextech_lamp: A gemstone floating in a brass cage. Bright as day, never goes out. Stands or hangs like a lantern.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.magic_stone: 2 lapis lazuli, then stone, into a boiling crucible
quest.hextale.magic_stone.goal: make magic stone in the crucible
quest.hextale.magic_stone.desc: Lapis gives magic to boiling water. What if stone sat in that water long enough? It might drink the magic in.
jei.hextale.info.magic_stone: Stone that drank magic. Lapis gives magic to boiling water in a crucible; plain stone dropped into that water drinks it in and rises out changed.
quest.hextale.magic_sapling.goal: grow a Magic Tree Sprout in the crucible
quest.hextale.magic_sapling.desc: A sapling is a promise of wood. Fed in a crucible on magic, plant and sap, it might promise more.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.magic_sapling: magic, plant and sap in the water, then a sapling
jei.hextale.info.magic_sapling: A sapling thrown into a crucible rich in magic, plant and sap drinks them in and comes out as something else. But first I have to understand it at the Lab Bench. Its wood won't burn.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.nothing.rune: The circle waits for runes on its steles: %s
book.hextale.quest.infusion.runes: Runes chosen on steles around the altar
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a pickaxe
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.clas: %s and %s are incompatible on one pickaxe
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: a pickaxe holds four runes (a grindstone takes them off)
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.noth: The pickaxe already carries these runes with as many stars
book.hextale.quest.pickaxe_rune.note: Room for %s runes on a pickaxe. A grindstone takes them all off again.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note: Pickaxe on the altar, rune on a stele. Up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.pickaxe_rune.goal: burn a rune into a hextech pickaxe
quest.hextale.pickaxe_rune.desc: What if I lay the pickaxe alone on the altar and set a rune on a stele beside it? The rune might burn into the metal like an enchantment.
quest.hextale.refined_pickaxe.desc: Hexsteel and two gemstones on top of the old pickaxe. Harder, keener - and it remembers everything the old one carried.
quest.hextale.radiant_pickaxe.desc: The pickaxe shines now and fire doesn't touch it. Stronger than anything I've held, and still mine, runes and all.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.smelting.desc: The ore comes out of the stone already hot and smelted.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.tempering.desc: The pickaxe wears slower, and hard stone gives way sooner.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.erosion.desc: Strike one piece of ore and the whole vein follows. (Shift - one block)
pickaxe_rune.hextale.insight.desc: I can almost see the ore glowing through the stone. (Right click)
pickaxe_rune.hextale.lens.desc: The other runes seem to burn one star brighter, up to ★★★★.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.drill.desc: The stone around the blow crumbles too. (Shift - one block)
pickaxe_rune.hextale.forge.desc: Sometimes the ore gives twice as much.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.gemstone.desc: Now and then plain stone hides a gem.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.magnet.desc: Whatever falls - and the experience - drifts to my hands.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.cache.desc: The drops skip the floor and go straight to my bag.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.passage.desc: The rock ahead opens into a tunnel. (Right click)
pickaxe_rune.hextale.quake.desc: The stone around shatters, but the ore stays whole. (Right click)
multiblock.hextale.big_essence_jar.forme: The Big Essence Jar wakes up
quest.hextale.big_essence_jar.goal: build a Big Essence Jar and wake it
quest.hextale.big_essence_jar.desc: One jar is never enough. What if I build a whole jar out of glass blocks and a wooden lid, and wake it with a touch of hextech? It would hold as much as a whole shelf of jars.
book.hextale.guide.wip_status: Only an idea in the margins so far
book.hextale.guide.no_use: No use for it yet. It feels like it leads somewhere, though.
book.hextale.guide.researched_at_lab: Worked out at the Lab Bench
item.hextale.scroll_of_omniscience.desc: Right click: learn every rune with three stars, study every item, complete every quest.
item.hextale.scroll_of_oblivion.desc: Right click: forget all runes, studied items and quests.
item.hextale.void_shard.desc: A sliver of the Void. It is cold, and the air around it seems to lean in. What happens if I point it somewhere?
item.hextale.void_shard.controls: RMB: open the Void. Shift + RMB: close the Void in sight, or pick another shape
subtitles.hextale.essence.draw: Essence is drawn from a jar
quest.hextale.wip_quench_tank.desc: What if red-hot tools were quenched in essence instead of water? They might come out tougher.
quest.hextale.wip_rune_lock.desc: A chest or a door that opens only for the one who set the rune. Thieves would hate it.
quest.hextale.wip_beam_relay.desc: Mirrors passing a beam of light and power from block to block. I need to think about the angles.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_cutter.desc: A beam that cuts blocks into stairs and patterns right where they stand. No more carrying stone to the cutter.
quest.hextale.wip_signal_beacon.desc: A beam into the sky that friends can see from far away. And maybe marks to leave for them.
quest.hextale.wip_mirage_projector.desc: Ghostly blocks and pictures in the air. A false wall nobody would suspect...
quest.hextale.wip_flash_charge.desc: A charge that bursts into a blinding flash. Useful when something with too many teeth gets close.
quest.hextale.wip_storm_collector.desc: Catching lightning without the risk of a blast. If I could tame the storm, hextech would grow by itself.
quest.hextale.wip_levitation_plate.desc: A plate where whatever stands on it gently floats. Maybe the first thing anyone ever tried with hextech.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_lift.desc: A platform that carries me and my loads up and down. Ladders are getting old.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_gate.desc: A pair of gates that carry you a short way in a blink. How short - I don't know yet.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_turret.desc: Something that strikes the monsters near the base with lightning while I'm busy with research.
quest.hextale.wip_barrier_ward.desc: A dome that keeps out monsters and arrows. A quiet night at last.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_flamethrower.desc: Fiery essence pushed through a nozzle. It would light up the darkest cave - and everything in it.
quest.hextale.wip_veil.desc: A cloak that makes its wearer unseen and unheard. Tempting - and a little frightening.
quest.hextale.wip_acid_bath.desc: A bath that dissolves ore straight into essence. But what would it do to the ground around it?
quest.hextale.wip_rune_anvil.desc: Mending tools with essence instead of iron, keeping every rune and enchantment. That would save so much.
quest.hextale.wip_greenhouse.desc: Plants around it growing faster... magic stone, glass, a little light essence? Let me think.
quest.hextale.wip_healing_spring.desc: Water that heals whoever steps in. A place to come back to after a bad day underground.
quest.hextale.wip_respirator.desc: A mask against the poisonous fumes. If chemtech goes where I think it goes, I'll need one.
quest.hextale.wip_fireproof_coat.desc: A coat that fire and lava can't touch. The deep places would be a lot less scary.
quest.hextale.wip_construct.desc: A little helper that does what its runes tell it. What would I ask it to do first?
quest.hextale.wip_sap_tap.desc: A brass spout driven into a living trunk, dripping sap essence into a bottle. Essence without boiling anything - is that possible?
quest.hextale.wip_essence_sprinkler.desc: A turning head on a pipe spraying essence dew over the beds. Water to keep them moist, sap to hurry the crops.
quest.hextale.wip_living_soil.desc: Farmland soaked in essence the way stone soaks up magic. It might never dry out or get trampled.
quest.hextale.wip_field_ward.desc: A post with a hextech eye watching over the fields. Nothing would spawn there, nothing would trample the beds.
quest.hextale.wip_seed_sower.desc: A clockwork brass bird hopping over empty farmland and planting seeds from a chest. Silly - but I'd love to see it.
quest.hextale.wip_feeding_trough.desc: A trough that feeds and breeds the animals around it and stops when the pen is full. No more running around with wheat.
quest.hextale.wip_geode_resonator.desc: A humming fork set into budding amethyst. If the crystals grew faster, there'd be more for the storms. Too many forks might crack them, though.
quest.hextale.wip_jar_gauge.desc: A dial on a jar showing how full it is - and telling redstone about it.
quest.hextale.wip_fish_weir.desc: A brass net lowered into open water, fishing by itself. Slowly - but it never gets bored.
quest.hextale.wip_compost_vat.desc: Plant scraps and the dark leftovers rotting into something useful. Better than pouring it all away.
quest.hextale.wip_the_gray.desc: Poured-out murk doesn't just vanish, does it? I have a bad feeling about where it goes.
quest.hextale.wip_experiment_pot.desc: A pot under a glass cap on the lab bench. A plant that takes a dose and changes... into what?
quest.hextale.wip_specimen_cage.desc: What if I dripped a brew on a living beast? Hard to imagine what would come of it. First I need a sturdy cage.
quest.hextale.hextech_axe.goal: make a Hextech Axe at the altar
quest.hextale.hextech_axe.desc: Iron axe, crystal edge. It bites into wood as if the tree wanted to fall. I'd like to see what a rune does to it.
quest.hextale.hextech_shovel.goal: make a Hextech Shovel at the altar
quest.hextale.hextech_shovel.desc: The crystal point goes through sand and gravel like water. And it barely wears. Runes would fit here too.
quest.hextale.hextech_sword.goal: make a Hextech Sword at the altar
quest.hextale.hextech_sword.desc: The guard is a hexagon around the crystal heart, the blade ends in living crystal. It hums when I swing it. What would a rune make of it?
quest.hextale.wip_hextech_hoe.desc: A hoe that tills a whole bed at once and reaps as it goes. Runes of life would suit it.
quest.hextale.wip_xp_condenser.desc: Experience orbs drawn into a glass coil and condensed into essence. Could knowledge be bottled?
quest.hextale.wip_ore_washer.desc: Raw ore washed in streams of water essence. Three pieces where there were two?
quest.hextale.wip_herd_warden.desc: A post with a soothing gem: it shears, milks, gathers eggs. The animals wouldn't even notice.
quest.hextale.wip_bloom_censer.desc: A hanging censer breathing pollen. Flowers spreading, bees working twice as hard...
quest.hextale.wip_magma_font.desc: Pour enough fire essence into stone and it should melt into lava. Expensive - but the forge would never cool.
quest.hextale.wip_rain_caller.desc: A mast that seeds the clouds with mist. Rain for the fields - or a storm for my lightning rods.
quest.hextale.wip_world_anchor.desc: A heavy grounded weight that keeps the land awake while I'm away. The farms would go on without me.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_bore.desc: A rune drill sinking a shaft into the depths layer by layer, leaving a ladder of light behind. Pickaxe runes might fit it.
quest.hextale.wip_shadow_coffer.desc: Two coffers sealed with one rune, sharing one pocket in the shadow. Put something in here - take it out there.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_archive.desc: Shelves of rune-sealed drawers and one floating index. A hall full of chests is getting hard to live with.
quest.hextale.wip_winged_courier.desc: A little flying construct carrying things where no beam reaches - over rivers, through caves.
quest.hextale.wip_crystal_vat.desc: Growing hextech in a chemical bath instead of waiting for storms. Cheaper... but the air around it worries me.
quest.hextale.wip_mutation_injector.desc: A needle that gives a creature a dose right where it stands. Stronger and loyal - or a monster.
quest.hextale.wip_chrono_chamber.desc: A glass dome where time runs faster for whatever is inside. How long would the glass hold?

pylon_rune.hextale.lift.desc: The pylon carries more at once.
pylon_rune.hextale.lens.desc: The other runes seem to burn one star brighter.

block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: a pylon holds three runes
quest.hextale.gathering_pylon.goal: make a Gathering Pylon at the altar
quest.hextale.gathering_pylon.desc: Instead of a clumsy mechanical arm - the pull of a gem. Set on a chest or a furnace, it reaches for things lying around and lowers them into what it stands on. I wonder how far it can reach.
quest.hextale.sending_pylon.goal: make a Sending Pylon at the altar
quest.hextale.sending_pylon.desc: This one gives instead of taking: whatever the storage under it gives out, it carries to where I point. A furnace even sorts what it gets by itself. (Right click the pylon, then where it should send)
quest.hextale.relay_pylon.goal: make Relay Pylons at the altar
quest.hextale.relay_pylon.desc: A column that neither takes nor gives - it only passes things along. With a few of them I could reach across the whole base.
quest.hextale.pylon_rune.goal: burn a rune into a pylon
quest.hextale.pylon_rune.desc: Pylons have room for runes too. Lay one alone on the altar... I'd like it to reach further and move faster.
jei.hextale.info.gathering_pylon: On a container it reaches for the items lying around and lowers them in. With nothing under it, it passes them along its links. (Right click with an empty hand - what it does now)
jei.hextale.info.sending_pylon: On a container it carries what comes out of it to wherever I point. A furnace even sorts what it gets. (Right click the pylon, then the target - link; again - unlink; Shift + right click with an empty hand - drop all links)
jei.hextale.info.relay_pylon: Takes nothing for itself - items and essence only pass through it to its own links. A chain of them reaches far.

block.hextale.sending_pylon.hint: On a chest it carries what's inside to wherever I point.

quest.hextale.siphon_pylon.goal: make a Siphon Pylon at the altar
quest.hextale.siphon_pylon.desc: Pipes without pipes. Set on a jar, it could draw the essence up and pour it as a stream of light wherever I point.
jei.hextale.info.siphon_pylon: On a jar it pours the essence as a stream of light to whatever takes it. (Right click it, then the target)
item.hextale.pylon_filter.hint: A way to tell a pylon what to take and what to leave. (Right click - set up; on a pylon - set in; Shift on a pylon - take out)
item.hextale.pylon_filter.not_here: A siphon carries essence: give it an Essence Sticker instead
item.hextale.essence_sticker.blank: Blank: right click to choose its essence
item.hextale.essence_sticker.hint: On a jar it should keep out every other essence. A mixture won't get through either.
item.hextale.essence_sticker.not_here: A sticker goes on a jar, a siphon or a relay
gui.hextale.sticker.title: Essence on the sticker
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.tip.list: Only these: only the listed items pass. All but these: the listed items never pass. An empty filter lets everything pass.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.tip.exact: Kind: every stack of that item. Exact: only with the same enchantments, contents and damage.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.tip.rule: Numbers (with "Only these"): keep N - a sending pylon leaves N of each item in its container; fill up to N - an item goes in only while the target holds fewer than N. Scroll over a slot to set N, with shift by ten.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.empty: Empty: everything passes. Put items into the slots.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.blackli: Everything passes except the items here.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.keep: Only these pass, and N of each stays behind.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.limit: Only these pass, each up to N in the target.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.slot.empty: Click with an item to put it here
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.slot.hint: Click: replace or clear · scroll: N (shift: by ten)
quest.hextale.pylon_filter.goal: make a Filter at the altar
quest.hextale.pylon_filter.desc: The pylons grab everything. I need a way to tell them what to take, what to leave and how much to keep back. (Right click to set it up, then right click a pylon)
quest.hextale.essence_sticker.goal: make Essence Stickers at the altar
quest.hextale.essence_sticker.desc: A little hex-inked label of one essence. On a jar it might keep out everything else. A mixture, though, stays a mixture - no label will split it.
block.hextale.hex_pylon.link.no_load: Nothing here takes items or essence

item.hextale.research_notes.known: You have researched %s already. Hand the notes to another researcher.
item.hextale.research_notes.learned: Researched: %s. You can make it now.

gui.hextale.research_table.researched: Researched already: this makes a copy of the notes
gui.hextale.research_table.burn.hint: Start this research over on a fresh sheet with a new board. The paper is lost, the orb and the ink stay.
gui.hextale.research_table.burn.confirm: Click again to burn the parchment
gui.hextale.research_table.goal.hint: Reach it with the ink; a step onto it costs %s of its essence
gui.hextale.research_table.corner.hint: Every step towards this corner is paid with it
book.hextale.runes.title: Runes found: %s
book.hextale.runes.none: Not a single rune yet. They aren't invented - they're found on scrolls in the chests of old places. The deeper and more dangerous the place, the stranger the rune.
gui.hextale.stele.refuse.one_scroll: A scroll takes one rune: clear the rune on the other stele
block.hextale.hextech_altar.write.one_ru: To copy a rune you need a blank scroll on the altar, one rune on one stele and empty pedestals
quest.hextale.rune_scroll.goal: find a rune scroll and read it
quest.hextale.rune_scroll.desc: Runes can't be invented - only found. Old dungeons, temples, mineshafts... the deeper and darker the place, the stranger the runes. When I find one, I read it and it stays with me.
quest.hextale.blank_scroll.desc: Three sheets of paper rolled together. Could a rune I know be copied onto it - and given to someone else?
quest.hextale.written_scroll.goal: copy a rune onto a scroll
quest.hextale.written_scroll.desc: A blank scroll alone on the altar, one rune on a stele, empty pedestals. The altar writes the rune out as I know it. Knowledge can travel after all.
jei.hextale.info.blank_scroll: A blank scroll alone on the altar, one rune I know on a stele - and the altar writes it out.
jei.hextale.info.rune_scroll: Runes are found, not invented: in chests of old places. Simple ones lie close to the surface, the strange ones deep in the most dangerous ruins. How well a scroll is written is pure luck.
jei.hextale.info.research_notes: Everything I worked out, written down. Reading it teaches how to make the thing - and the notes can be handed to someone else. (Right click)
item.hextale.unstable_hextech.throw: And if I threw it on purpose? (Right click)
item.hextale.hextech_dust.tooltip: Glitters and tingles. I wonder what it would wake if I sprinkled it on something.
item.hextale.hextech_crystal.tooltip: Cut along its seams, it has finally calmed down.
block.hextale.crucible.say.not_a_bucket: Not enough water for a bucket
block.hextale.crucible.say.full: There is no room for more water
block.hextale.crucible.say.not_boiling: Only boiling water takes things in - heat it from below and wait
block.hextale.crucible.say.no_water: The crucible is dry: pour in a water bucket or water bottles

gui.hextale.hex_workbench.charge.hint: Hextech in the socket soaks into the bench as charge (raw %s, crystal %s, gemstone %s, up to %s); every craft spends some.
gui.hextale.slot.hex_workbench.crystal: A hextech crystal: its charge powers the crafts

gui.hextale.hex_furnace.locked: This alloy must be researched first
gui.hextale.slot.hex_furnace.input: A metal for the alloy: up to three different ones
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.no_crystal: Put a crystal into the clamp
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.wrong_disc: A crystal is finished only on a master disc
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.heat.hint: Grinding heats the crystal, resting cools it. At the top it cracks.
gui.hextale.slot.hex_lapidary.input: Raw hextech, or a hextech crystal to finish
gui.hextale.slot.hex_lapidary.output: The cut stone (or dust, if it shattered)
quest.hextale.hextech_dust.desc: The orb can't take a blow at all. If I throw it, it shatters into glittering dust. Strange - the dust feels just as alive. (Right click to throw)
quest.hextale.hex_workbench.desc: What if I sprinkle the dust on an ordinary crafting table? It sinks into the wood... and the table seems to wake up. A crystal in its socket keeps it charged.
quest.hextale.crucible.desc: I sprinkle a pinch of hextech dust into an old cauldron - and it comes alive. Boiling water swallows whatever I drop in. But some things don't dissolve; they take on a new shape instead. How could I use that?
quest.hextale.hex_furnace.desc: Dust on a furnace this time. It wakes hungry for metals - two or three at once, melted together. Some alloys it won't touch until I understand them.
quest.hextale.sphalerite.desc: A dull brown stone with honey-coloured grains, deep in the rock like copper, only rarer. Zinc, I think.
quest.hextale.zinc.desc: Raw zinc melts in any furnace. Grey, plain - and exactly what copper was missing.
quest.hextale.hex_lapidary.desc: Raw hextech has hidden seams. If I turn it over a disc until the seam lines up and grind in short strokes, it might split cleanly. Too much heat and it cracks...
quest.hextale.hextech_crystal.desc: Cut along its seams, the orb finally calms down. It holds a charge and doesn't burst. Most of what comes next will be built around one of these.
quest.hextale.hexsteel.desc: Iron, coal and a little hextech dust melted together - a dark blue steel. It keeps an edge like nothing else.
quest.hextale.master_cutting_disc.desc: The old disc is too coarse for the finer cut. Hexsteel edged with diamond might do it - more planes, less room for a mistake.
quest.hextale.wip_auto_workbench.desc: A workbench that repeats a recipe on its own while its charge lasts. My hands would thank me.
quest.hextale.wip_dust_charge.desc: Hextech dust packed tight bursts in a bright flash. For blasting stone - or for signals?
quest.hextale.wip_clockwork.desc: Brass gears and springs - little machines wound by hand that keep ticking for a while.
quest.hextale.wip_gas_grenade.desc: A vial in a hinged shell that bursts into a lingering cloud. Better not stand downwind.
quest.hextale.wip_catalyst_salts.desc: Brews boiled dry leave crystals behind. Maybe they make other reactions run faster?
quest.hextale.wip_chem_boiler.desc: A pressure tank over the green flame. Steam like that could drive presses, drills, pumps...
quest.hextale.wip_chem_press.desc: A steam press that crushes ore and flattens metal in one heavy stroke.
quest.hextale.wip_chem_drill.desc: A hissing drill on a hose from the boiler. Fast, loud - and leaking fumes.
quest.hextale.wip_chem_tank_suit.desc: Armour with a tank on the back pumping gas into the wearer. Strength now... and the price later?
quest.hextale.wip_chem_lumen.desc: A gas street lamp with a green flame that keeps burning in the thickest smog.
quest.hextale.wip_apex_shimmer.desc: A drop that closes any wound at once. I'm afraid of how much the body would want the next one.
quest.hextale.wip_shimmer_engine.desc: Shimmer burned in a pink flame - the strongest fuel I know, and the least stable. An engine on it would roar.
quest.hextale.wip_shimmer_arm.desc: A mechanical arm fed by shimmer, lifting and striking far beyond human strength.
quest.hextale.wip_growth_serum.desc: A dose that makes crops shoot up in days. What does it take from the soil in return?
quest.hextale.wip_mutant_reagents.desc: Dosed creatures might shed strange tissue - things no plant or stone could give.
quest.hextale.wip_mutated_beasts.desc: Animals pushed too far by doses: larger, stronger, veined with purple. And not friendly at all.
quest.hextale.wip_fume_hood.desc: The crucible's fumes have to be drawn away. But they'll have to go somewhere.
quest.hextale.wip_smog_scrubber.desc: Pulling the smog out of the air and pressing it into cakes. Someone has to clean up after chemtech.
quest.hextale.wip_rust_blight.desc: Where the smog settles, metal rusts and crystals cloud over. The machines will need guarding.
quest.hextale.wip_recall_device.desc: A device that rewinds where I stand a few seconds back. Not my wounds, though.
quest.hextale.wip_gem_sockets.desc: Cut stones set into armour and tools, each facet bending a little of their power.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_bow.desc: A crossbow that charges its bolt with a crystal's spark. I can almost hear it.
quest.hextale.wip_mining_gauntlet.desc: A gauntlet that cracks stone with a punch. I suspect overusing it would hurt.
jei.hextale.info.hex_furnace: A furnace woken by hextech dust. It melts two or three metals together into an alloy on ordinary fuel. Some alloys it won't touch until I understand them.
jei.hextale.info.crucible: A cauldron woken by hextech dust. Water and fire under it - and once it boils, it swallows whatever I drop in. Some things don't dissolve, but take on another shape. The water can be bailed out with a bucket, or boiled off. (Shift + right click with an empty hand - boil off)
jei.hextale.info.hex_workbench: A crafting table woken by hextech dust. Almost every device is made here, and every craft takes a little charge from the crystal in its socket. What I haven't worked out yet, it won't show.
jei.hextale.info.hex_lapidary: Raw hextech has hidden seams. Turn it until the seam lines up with the disc and grind in short strokes - too much heat, or the wrong angle, and it cracks. A finer disc finishes crystals into gemstones.
jei.hextale.info.hextech_dust: A thrown orb shatters into glittering dust. Sprinkled on a crafting table or a furnace, the dust wakes it up. (Right click)
jei.hextale.working.lightning: Lightning on the rod shatters the amethyst - and every crystal touching it.
jei.hextale.working.throw: A thrown orb shatters into dust. (Right click)
jei.hextale.working.awaken: Dust sprinkled on the block wakes it. (Right click)
jei.hextale.working.finish: Finished smooth with a finer disc.
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.turn: Turn the crystal (wheel or A/D) until the band glows green
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.aligned: Green! Hold the mouse or space to grind
block.hextale.crucible.say.no_essences: There is nothing in it for the water to dissolve
jei.hextale.info.essence: One of the essences everything is made of. Things carry them - studying a thing shows which. Searching for an essence's name finds the studied things that carry it.
block.hextale.whirl_reaper.hint: Whirls of wind for the ripe crops around it. Without air essence nearby it just stands still.
block.hextale.whirl_reaper.status: Field %sx%s, a whirl every %s s, air for %s whirls
block.hextale.whirl_reaper.status.becalm: Becalmed: no air essence in the jars nearby
reaper_rune.hextale.shift.desc: The field it watches grows wider.
reaper_rune.hextale.lens.desc: The other runes seem to burn one star brighter.

quest.hextale.whirl_reaper.goal: make a Whirl Reaper at the altar
quest.hextale.whirl_reaper.desc: The crystal stirs the air into little whirls. Set among the beds, it might reap the ripe plants for me and leave them ready to grow again. It needs air to work - air essence from a jar nearby.
jei.hextale.info.whirl_reaper: Whirls of wind for every ripe plant in its field. Crops start again from a sprout, melons and pumpkins are lifted off, cane and cactus are cut above the root. It drinks air essence from jars nearby.
block.hextale.hex_sawmill.hint: Grown trees around it had better watch out. It plants new ones, though - and drinks air essence nearby.
block.hextale.hex_sawmill.status: Grove %sx%s, a saw every %s s, air for %s trees
block.hextale.hex_sawmill.status.becalme: Becalmed: no air essence in the jars nearby
sawmill_rune.hextale.motor.desc: The saws fly out more often.
sawmill_rune.hextale.lens.desc: The other runes seem to burn one star brighter.
book.hextale.quest.sawmill_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the sawmill.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_sawmill: Put the Hex Sawmill alone on the altar; up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.hex_sawmill.goal: make a Hex Sawmill at the altar
quest.hextale.hex_sawmill.desc: A disc spun by the wind in an old stump. Set in a grove, it might fell the grown trees and plant new ones in their place. My walls of logs are safe, I hope. It runs on air essence too.
jei.hextale.info.hex_sawmill: Fells the grown trees around it, leaves and all, drops everything at the stump and plants a sapling back. Log walls are safe. It drinks air essence from jars nearby.
block.hextale.sorting_matrix.hint: On my dump chest it sends everything home - to the chests nearby that already keep the same thing.

goggles.hextale.pylon.pace_kinds: Every %s s, %s of each item, up to %s kinds
quest.hextale.sorting_matrix.goal: make a Sorting Matrix at the altar
quest.hextale.sorting_matrix.desc: A lattice of lenses over my dump chest. Whatever I throw in, it sends home - to the chest nearby that already holds the same thing. Want a chest for cobblestone? Put one cobblestone in it.
jei.hextale.info.sorting_matrix: On my dump chest it sends everything home - to the chests, barrels and boxes nearby that already hold the same thing. A relay with a filter can become a home too; furnaces get what they cook. What has no home stays put.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.haste.desc: Sometimes my hands get faster while I dig.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: The ore seems more generous, as if the pickaxe were lucky.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: More experience from the ore; even plain stone shares a little now and then.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.breath.desc: Digging keeps me fed a little, and under water each block gives back a breath.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.banishing.desc: In the dark my eyes adjust as I dig.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.fireproofing.desc: When a block opens onto lava, the heat doesn't reach me.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.eternal_flame.desc: In the dark a little wisp of light may stay where the block was.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.mending.desc: The pickaxe sometimes shrugs off wear and even mends itself.
reaper_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: A reaped plant sometimes springs back as if bone-mealed.
reaper_rune.hextale.pollen.desc: Sometimes the harvest gives a little extra.
reaper_rune.hextale.photosynthesis.desc: Now and then the harvest comes out golden.
reaper_rune.hextale.spring.desc: Every harvest wets the soil around, and the neighbours may grow a step.
reaper_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: The harvest leaves experience hovering over the reaper.
reaper_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a whirl costs no air at all.
sawmill_rune.hextale.growth.desc: A freshly planted sapling sometimes shoots up at once.
sawmill_rune.hextale.pollen.desc: The leaves are more generous: saplings, sticks, apples.
sawmill_rune.hextale.blades.desc: A log sometimes gives one more.
sawmill_rune.hextale.photosynthesis.desc: A felled tree may leave a golden apple behind.
sawmill_rune.hextale.hush.desc: Bee nests come down whole and quiet, bees and honey inside.
sawmill_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a tree costs no air at all.
furnace_rune.hextale.forge.desc: Sometimes the ore gives one ingot more.
furnace_rune.hextale.eternal_flame.desc: Sometimes a melt burns no fuel at all.
furnace_rune.hextale.bellows.desc: The longer it works without a pause, the hotter it gets.
furnace_rune.hextale.reforging.desc: Old iron, gold and copper gear melts back into whole ingots, not nuggets.
furnace_rune.hextale.lens.desc: The other runes seem to burn one star brighter.
tool_rune.hextale.lens.desc: The other runes seem to burn one star brighter, up to ★★★★.
tool_rune.hextale.mending.desc: The tool sometimes shrugs off wear and even mends itself.
tool_rune.hextale.haste.desc: Sometimes my hands get faster while I work.
tool_rune.hextale.gravity.desc: One blow and the whole tree comes down, leaves and all. (Shift - one block)
tool_rune.hextale.growth.desc: A tree cut at its foot is planted again - from my bag, or sometimes out of nothing.
tool_rune.hextale.pollen.desc: The leaves are more generous: saplings, sticks, apples.
tool_rune.hextale.corrosion.desc: A blow sometimes eats into armour - it hurts more, and the armour wears.
tool_rune.hextale.cache.desc: Soil, sand and gravel sometimes hide a little treasure. Even a rune scroll?
tool_rune.hextale.erosion.desc: The soil around goes with every scoop. (Shift - one block)
tool_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: Grass and soil give up seeds, bulbs and saplings.
tool_rune.hextale.withering.desc: A blow sometimes gives a little life back to me.
tool_rune.hextale.chain_lightning.desc: A blow sometimes leaps on as lightning to the hostile creatures around.
tool_rune.hextale.bellows.desc: A kill sometimes fans my strength for a while.
tool_rune.hextale.flash.desc: The first blow on an unhurt creature lands harder.
tool_rune.hextale.engraving.desc: Sometimes a creature leaves its head behind.

brew.hextale.fuel.use: Burns hot and long - the green flame loves it.
brew.hextale.growth.use: Splash it on the garden and the plants hurry. The young ones grow up too.
brew.hextale.coolant.use: Splash it on fire and lava - neither likes it.
brew.hextale.glow.use: Where it splashes, cold green light stays behind. Creatures start to glow.
brew.hextale.acid.use: Hisses and eats - stone, iron, copper, monsters. The ore it leaves alone.

jei.hextale.info.chem_burner: An almost invisible green flame, hotter than lava. Whatever stands on it gets heat without coal or blaze powder, and it burns only while that thing works. It feeds on vials of combustible mix or on essence through pipes - the dark murk burns longest.
jei.hextale.info.chem_vial: With the right catalyst the essences in boiling water settle into a brew. A glass bottle on the crucible takes one dose. Some brews are meant to be thrown.
jei.hextale.info.rusted_plating: Acid on iron blocks eats them into rough, rusted plating. Ugly, but good to build with.
burner_rune.hextale.eternal_flame.desc: Sometimes a portion of fuel burns twice as long.
burner_rune.hextale.steam.desc: A brew over it sometimes yields one more dose.
burner_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Every brew over it leaves some experience.
burner_rune.hextale.fireproofing.desc: Standing by the lit burner, the heat doesn't touch me.
burner_rune.hextale.lens.desc: The other runes seem to burn one star brighter.

block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: a burner holds three runes
quest.hextale.chem_vial.desc: With the right catalyst the essences in boiling water settle into a brew - cheap, dirty and strong. Coal could make something that burns. But first I'd better work out the reaction.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.chem_vial: the catalyst into boiling water that holds its essences, then a glass bottle
quest.hextale.chem_glass.desc: Glass dropped into poisoned water comes back green and tough. What poison, though - something from the sea?
book.hextale.quest.scheme.chem_glass: venom in the water, then glass
quest.hextale.chem_burner.desc: An almost invisible green flame, hotter than lava. Whatever stands on it gets heat without coal or blaze powder. It only burns while the thing above it is working.
quest.hextale.rusted_plating.desc: Acid splashed on iron eats it into rough, rusted sheets. Ugly - but I could build with this.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.rusted_plating: a vial of acid thrown at an iron block
subtitles.hextale.crucible.brew: The crucible turns into a brew
brew.hextale.raw_shimmer.use: Burns long and pink. Too rough to drink - it needs refining.
brew.hextale.refined_shimmer.use: One sip and I'm stronger, faster and harder to hurt for a minute. Then the body needs time. It burns better than anything, too. (Right click - drink)

block.hextale.axolotl_tank.status.hungry: The axolotl is hungry: fish, or a bucket of tropical fish

quest.hextale.shimmerbloom.desc: Deep underground some caves glow violet from wall to wall. The flower that lights them seems to dream. What would it leave in boiling water?
quest.hextale.axolotl_tank.desc: An axolotl heals faster than anything alive. If I keep one in a glass tank and feed it fish... maybe it sheds what it doesn't need.
quest.hextale.regenerative_slime.desc: A lump of slime, still warm and alive with healing. The axolotl doesn't miss it at all.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.regenerative_s: an axolotl and fish in the tank
quest.hextale.raw_shimmer.desc: The blooms leave something dreamy in the water, and the slime seems to want it. Together, over a strong fire... the water turns violet. Raw shimmer. I have to understand this one first.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.raw_shimmer: 6 dream and 4 light in the water, then the slime
quest.hextale.chem_still.desc: A copper still over the green flame. Raw shimmer goes round the swan neck and drips out clearer. Two rough vials for one pure.
quest.hextale.refined_shimmer.desc: Pure shimmer glows magenta. One sip and I feel stronger than I should be... but the body needs time before the next. It also burns better than anything I know.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.refined_shimme: raw shimmer in a still over a lit burner
quest.hextale.pink_brazier.desc: Shimmer burning in an open bowl gives a cold pink flame. The plants around it seem to lean towards it.
quest.hextale.synthetic_crystal.desc: Amethyst and dust steeped in pure shimmer grow into a crystal. Cheaper than waiting for a storm - but weaker than a real one.
jei.hextale.info.shimmerbloom: Only deep underground, in caves that glow violet - most caves have none. It grows on floors and ceilings; bone meal plants a new one beside it.
jei.hextale.info.axolotl_tank: An axolotl in a glass tank, fed on fish. Now and then it sheds a lump of healing slime. A bucket brings it in and out unharmed.
jei.hextale.info.regenerative_slime: A lump of slime, still alive with healing. In boiling water full of dream and light, over a strong fire, it turns violet...
jei.hextale.info.chem_still: A copper still over the green flame. Two rough vials of shimmer go in, one pure drips out.
jei.hextale.info.pink_brazier: Shimmer burning in an open bowl. The plants in its pink light grow faster. Its flame never burns anything.
jei.hextale.info.synthetic_crystal: Grown from amethyst, dust and pure shimmer. Cheaper than a storm's crystal, weaker too - the workbench still takes it for charge.
quest.hextale.lab_bench.desc: For chemtech I will need other tools. A flask, droppers, a flame under the glass... Let's see what can be done with this.
book.hextale.quest.lab_first: Work it out at the Lab Bench first: %s
quest.hextale.growth_tonic.desc: Bone meal boiled into something green and eager. Splashed on the garden... I think the plants would hurry.
quest.hextale.coolant.desc: A snowball boiled into something that stays cold even in the heat. Fire wouldn't like it. Neither would lava.
quest.hextale.glow_mix.desc: Glowstone dust over a strong fire turns into a mix that glows by itself. Where it splashes, it might leave light behind.
quest.hextale.acid.desc: A fermented spider eye, only over the hottest green flame. It hisses and smokes. Stone, iron, monsters - I wonder what it won't eat.
lab_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a drop costs no essence.
lab_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Every sealed experiment leaves some experience.
lab_rune.hextale.heat_eater.desc: A flask about to burst sometimes lets its pressure out by itself.
lab_rune.hextale.lens.desc: The other runes seem to burn one star brighter.

skypack_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a take-off costs no air.
skypack_rune.hextale.breath.desc: Walls and the ground seem softer while I fly and right after.
skypack_rune.hextale.fireproofing.desc: Fire does not touch me while I fly.

quest.hextale.hextech_skypack.goal: make a Hextech Skypack at the altar
quest.hextale.hextech_skypack.desc: If a stable gemstone can make things float, could it carry me? Air essence in two tanks, the crystal between them, nozzles below. A jump, a second jump in the air - and then what?
jei.hextale.info.hextech_skypack: Worn like elytra. With air essence in its tanks: jump, then jump again in the air. A take-off from the ground fires the jets for two seconds like a firework rocket; after that it glides until the next take-off from the ground. Each take-off costs air. Refill from Essence Jars: right click one with the pack, or sneak beside them wearing it.
quest.hextale.magic_wood.desc: The pale wood keeps a faint warmth, as if it still remembers the essence it grew from. Too good for a fence.
quest.hextale.wip_arcane_cloth.desc: Wool left in the crucible overnight comes out heavy and warm, and the essence does not wash out. What could I sew from it?
quest.hextale.wip_researcher_coat.desc: Pockets for bottles, a high collar against the sparks. Unstable hextech seems to burst less often when I carry it inside.
quest.hextale.wip_essence_satchel.desc: Bottles clink and break in my pockets. A bag lined with the cloth might hold essence without any glass at all.
quest.hextale.wip_tuning_fork.desc: Struck against stone, the brass fork sings differently near ore, near water, near the orb. Could I hear what a block is made of without breaking it?
quest.hextale.wip_dust_lantern.desc: A pinch of dust behind glass flickers for hours. Not steady, and now and then it pops - but the workshop is brighter.
quest.hextale.wip_crystal_wand.desc: The old wand with a cut crystal where the dust was. It should reach further - start a ritual from across the room, turn a pylon without walking to it?
quest.hextale.wip_hexsteel_armor.desc: Hexsteel plates over the old coat. Heavy - but a crystal in the chest plate might carry the weight for me.
quest.hextale.wip_living_metal.desc: Hexsteel left inside the core overnight is warm in the morning and closes its own scratches. Is it still metal at all?
quest.hextale.wip_radiant_alloy.desc: Gold and gemstone dust melted in the core's light come out white. It rings like crystal and never tarnishes. Tools for a lifetime?
quest.hextale.wip_living_armor.desc: Armour that takes the shape of its wearer and mends its own dents. I should keep an eye on how long I wear it.
quest.hextale.wip_shifting_hammer.desc: A hammer that unfolds into something that fires. Two tools in one head - if the runes agree to share it.
quest.hextale.wip_matrix_scepter.desc: The core turns its tiles towards me when I come close with the wand. What if a piece of the matrix sat on the wand itself?
quest.hextale.wip_core_rituals.desc: Some things the altar refuses, however much essence I bring. The core does not refuse - it asks for more. What else can only be made here?
quest.hextale.wip_the_void.desc: Where the air stays grey the longest, something tore. There is no magic at all inside it - and it pulls. What will it leave behind when it closes?
quest.hextale.hand_loupe.desc: A lens in a brass ring. Before I build anything bigger, I want a closer look at what I already hold - or at the stone under my feet. (Hold right click; the other hand holds what to look at)
quest.hextale.hand_loupe.goal: make a Hand Loupe at the Hex Workbench
quest.hextale.magic_wand.desc: A rod of magic wood with a pinch of dust in its tip. It hums in the hand like the orb does. A light touch wakes things without spending any dust - and maybe something bigger will answer to it too?
quest.hextale.rune_chalk.desc: Magic stone ground with dust draws a line that does not smudge. A circle on the floor first - then whatever will stand inside it. (Right click the top of a block)
quest.hextale.nullstone.desc: Lime that sat in ash and shadow comes out of the crucible grey and heavy. Magic near it goes quiet. If rituals start getting out of hand, this might calm them - but how much can one stone drink?
quest.hextale.crystal_battery.desc: Somewhere to keep hextech's charge for later. A crystal in a brass cage - and the workbenches nearby never run dry. The machines I'm dreaming of will be hungry.
quest.hextale.crystal_battery.goal: make a Crystal Battery at the altar
item.hextale.hand_loupe.hint: Closer than the eye can see: whatever I hold in the other hand, or whatever stands in front of me.
item.hextale.hand_loupe.insight: While I was at it - %s too.
item.hextale.magic_wand.hint: It hums in the hand. A light touch seems enough to wake what dust used to wake - and the circle listens only to it.
item.hextale.magic_wand.controls: (Right click a block: wake it · Right click the altar: start the ritual, Shift: stop it)
item.hextale.rune_chalk.hint: The lines do not smudge. Around the altar the work seems to go quicker - or am I imagining it?
item.hextale.rune_chalk.controls: (Right click the top of a block: draw a rune)
block.hextale.hextech_altar.needs_wand: A ritual starts with a Magic Wand
jei.hextale.info.hand_loupe: Held to the eye it looks at what the other hand holds - or, with that hand empty, at the block in front. A long enough look and the thing goes into the diary with its essences, just like at the Research Table, only slower. (Hold right click)
jei.hextale.info.magic_wand: A touch wakes what dust wakes - a crafting table, a furnace, a cauldron - without spending dust; the wand wears a little instead. Only the wand starts a ritual at the Hextech Altar. (Right click)
jei.hextale.info.rune_chalk: Draws a rune on top of a solid block. Runes around a Hextech Altar make its rituals go quicker - the more, the quicker, up to ten - and glow while it works. A touch wipes them away.
jei.hextale.info.nullstone: Drinks stray magic. Near a Hexcore at work each stone takes some of its anger, and fills up with it - its veins glow brighter. A full stone stops drinking and slowly lets it out again. Made in the crucible: calcite in ash and shadow essence.
jei.hextale.info.crystal_battery: Keeps hextech charge. Give it crystals, orbs or gemstones; it feeds the Hex Workbenches around it. The fuller it is, the brighter its core - a comparator reads it too. (Right click with a crystal; with an empty hand - the charge)
loupe_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Something new seen leaves a little experience.
loupe_rune.hextale.insight.desc: Sometimes a fresh find teaches one more thing from my bag.
loupe_rune.hextale.lens.desc: The other runes seem to burn one star brighter.
book.hextale.quest.loupe_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the loupe.

wand_rune.hextale.mending.desc: The wood seems to heal its own cracks.
wand_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a touch costs the wand nothing.
wand_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: A ritual I started with the wand leaves experience when it ends well.
